name: Introduction and overview — Tu-160 Blackjack — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — Tu-160 Blackjack
description: Introduction and overview of the Tu-160 Blackjack: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The Tu-160 Blackjack is a four-engine supersonic strategic bomber built by Tupolev, entering service in 1987. It is the largest and heaviest combat aircraft ever built, with variable-sweep wings and a top speed above Mach 2. About 36 were built; Russia resumed production of the modernized Tu-160M in the 2020s. Baseline facts: Supersonic strategic bomber; service from 1987; ~36 built by Tupolev; largest combat aircraft ever..
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; the engine provides thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.

The Tu-160 Blackjack is a four-engine supersonic strategic bomber built by Tupolev, entering service in 1987. It is the largest and heaviest combat aircraft ever built, with variable-sweep wings and a top speed above Mach 2. About 36 were built; Russia resumed production of the modernized Tu-160M in the 2020s. Baseline facts: Supersonic strategic bomber; service from 1987; ~36 built by Tupolev; largest combat aircraft ever..
